# Trends

```{ojs}
viewof win = Inputs.radio(new Map([["Daily", 1], ["7-day", 7], ["28-day", 28]]), {
  label: "Trailing window", value: 7
})
viewof nTop = Inputs.range([5, Math.min(40, species.length)], {
  label: "Species shown", step: 1, value: 15
})
viewof norm = Inputs.radio(new Map([
  ["Share of all detections", "share"],
  ["Per active station-day", "per_station"]
]), { label: "Normalize by", value: "share" })
viewof logY = Inputs.toggle({ label: "Log scale (normalized)", value: false })
viewof picked = Inputs.select(species.map(d => d.common_name), {
  label: "Highlight (up to 8)", multiple: 8,
  value: species.slice(0, 5).map(d => d.common_name)
})
viewof units = Inputs.radio(["°C", "°F"], { label: "Temperature", value: "°C" })
```

### Row {height="9%"}

```{ojs}
//| padding: 0
// Overview of total daily detections; drag to set the date range.
// The selection lives in brushState so card resizes do not reset it.
viewof range = {
  const strip = Plot.plot({
    marginLeft: 60, marginRight: 150, marginTop: 4, marginBottom: 18,
    x: { label: null, ticks: 8 }, y: { axis: null },
    marks: [Plot.areaY(dates.map((d, i) => ({ d, t: total[i] })), { x: "d", y: "t", fill: "#4a4a4a", fillOpacity: 0.5, curve: "step" })]
  });
  const x = strip.scale("x"), y = strip.scale("y");
  strip.value = brushState.sel;
  if (x.range[1] - x.range[0] < 10 || y.range[0] - y.range[1] < 4) return strip;
  const set = sel => {
    brushState.sel = sel;
    strip.value = sel;
    strip.dispatchEvent(new Event("input"));
  };
  const brush = d3.brushX()
    .extent([[x.range[0], y.range[1]], [x.range[1], y.range[0]]])
    .on("end", ({ selection, sourceEvent }) => {
      if (sourceEvent) set(selection ? selection.map(px => x.invert(px)) : null);
    });
  const g = d3.select(strip).append("g").call(brush);
  if (brushState.sel) g.call(brush.move, brushState.sel.map(d => x.apply(d)));
  g.on("dblclick", () => { g.call(brush.clear); set(null); });
  return strip;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Data. Payload is columnar; build typed arrays once.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
meta = bw.meta
nDays = meta.n_days
dates = Array.from({ length: nDays }, (_, i) => new Date((meta.first_day + i) * 864e5))
species = transpose(bw.species)
// Okabe-Ito, reordered so the low-contrast yellow is used last.
okabeIto = ["#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#009E73", "#CC79A7", "#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#000000", "#F0E442"]

// Quarto measures cards before the dashboard layout settles and while tabs
// are hidden; nudge its resize handler after load and on every tab switch.
resizeNudge = {
  const nudge = () => window.dispatchEvent(new Event("resize"));
  [400, 1500].forEach(ms => setTimeout(nudge, ms));
  document.addEventListener("shown.bs.tab", nudge);
}

num = a => Float64Array.from(a, v => v == null ? NaN : v)
slice = (col, k) => col.slice(k * nDays, (k + 1) * nDays)

counts = species.map(s => num(slice(bw.series.count, s.idx)))
ranks = Object.fromEntries(meta.windows.map(w =>
  [w, species.map(s => num(slice(bw.series["r" + w], s.idx)))]))

total = num(bw.daily.total)
nStations = num(bw.daily.n_stations)

// Trailing sum over w days; NaN until the window is full.
function roll(a, w) {
  const out = new Float64Array(a.length).fill(NaN);
  let s = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
    s += a[i] || 0;
    if (i >= w) s -= a[i - w] || 0;
    if (i >= w - 1) out[i] = s;
  }
  return out;
}

// Trailing mean that skips missing values.
function rollMean(a, w) {
  const out = new Float64Array(a.length).fill(NaN);
  for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
    let s = 0, n = 0;
    for (let j = Math.max(0, i - w + 1); j <= i; j++) if (Number.isFinite(a[j])) { s += a[j]; n++; }
    if (n) out[i] = s / n;
  }
  return out;
}

brushState = { return { sel: null }; }

// Index range [i0, i1] from the brush.
idxRange = {
  const [a, b] = range ?? [dates[0], dates[nDays - 1]];
  return [
    Math.max(0, Math.round((a - dates[0]) / 864e5)),
    Math.min(nDays - 1, Math.round((b - dates[0]) / 864e5))
  ];
}

// Top species by detections inside the selected range.
visible = {
  const [i0, i1] = idxRange;
  return species
    .map((s, k) => {
      let t = 0;
      for (let i = i0; i <= i1; i++) t += counts[k][i] || 0;
      return { ...s, k, inRange: t };
    })
    .sort((a, b) => b.inRange - a.inRange)
    .slice(0, nTop);
}

colorOf = {
  const m = new Map(picked.map((n, i) => [n, okabeIto[i % 8]]));
  return n => m.get(n) ?? "#9a9a9a";
}

// Long rows for the visible species and dates, grey series first so that
// highlighted ones draw on top.
rows = {
  const [i0, i1] = idxRange;
  const denom = roll(norm === "share" ? total : nStations, win);
  const order = [...visible].sort((a, b) => picked.includes(a.common_name) - picked.includes(b.common_name));
  const out = [];
  for (const s of order) {
    const r = ranks[win][s.k], c = roll(counts[s.k], win);
    for (let i = i0; i <= i1; i++) {
      const v = denom[i] > 0 ? c[i] / denom[i] : NaN;
      out.push({ date: dates[i], sp: s.common_name, rank: r[i], value: norm === "share" ? 100 * v : v, n: c[i] });
    }
  }
  return out;
}

seriesOrder = [...new Set(rows.map(d => d.sp))]

// Hover highlighting. Plot draws one <path> per series in data order.
function highlight(chart) {
  const paths = chart.querySelectorAll('g[aria-label="line"] path');
  chart.addEventListener("input", () => {
    const sp = chart.value?.sp;
    paths.forEach((p, i) => {
      const on = !sp || seriesOrder[i] === sp;
      p.setAttribute("stroke-opacity", on ? (picked.includes(seriesOrder[i]) || sp ? 1 : 0.45) : 0.08);
      p.setAttribute("stroke-width", sp && seriesOrder[i] === sp ? 3 : (picked.includes(seriesOrder[i]) ? 2 : 1));
    });
  });
  chart.dispatchEvent(new Event("input"));
  return chart;
}

winLabel = win === 1 ? "daily" : `trailing ${win}-day`
xDomain = [dates[idxRange[0]], dates[idxRange[1]]]

tempRows = {
  const [i0, i1] = idxRange;
  const conv = units === "°C" ? (t => t) : (t => t * 9 / 5 + 32);
  const lo = rollMean(num(bw.daily.tmin), win), mid = rollMean(num(bw.daily.tmean), win),
        hi = rollMean(num(bw.daily.tmax), win), puc = num(bw.daily.puc_tmean);
  const out = [];
  for (let i = i0; i <= i1; i++) out.push({ date: dates[i], lo: conv(lo[i]), mid: conv(mid[i]), hi: conv(hi[i]), puc: conv(puc[i]) });
  return out;
}
```

# Methods

## Row

### Column {width="55%"}

::: {.card title="Data and definitions"}
**Source.** BirdWeather station detections (BirdNET classifier) pulled with the `birdweatheR` R package.
Stations are those whose public coordinates fall inside the Forsyth County, NC boundary from `maps::county` (39-vertex polygon, about 1 km precision).
Stations with location privacy enabled report fuzzed coordinates and may be misassigned near the county line.

**Counts.** Server-side daily species counts per station (`dailyDetectionCounts`), summed across stations.
Each station's own BirdNET confidence threshold applies; no further confidence filter is applied.
Counts are detections, not individuals.
A single loud, persistent bird near one station can dominate.

**Rank.** For each day, species are ranked by their trailing-window detection sum among all species detected in the county (competition ranking, ties share the lower rank).
Ranks are computed over every species before the top-N filter, so a rank is the county-wide rank.

**Normalized count.** Two options.
*Share* is species detections divided by all detections in the same window, which removes station-count growth but is compositional (one species rising lowers all others).
*Per active station-day* divides by the number of station-days with at least one detection, which assumes stations that are online but silent are rare.

**Temperature.** Line and band are ERA5 reanalysis daily mean, min, and max at the county centroid from the Open-Meteo archive (about 5 days of lag), smoothed with the same trailing window.
Points are the mean across BirdWeather PUC stations of each station's daily mean on-board sensor temperature, kept only for days with at least 500 readings (about 25% of a full day).
PUC sensors sit in an enclosure and can read warm in direct sun.

**Assumptions that can fail.** Station effort is not constant (stations join, go offline, and move).
Detection probability varies by species, distance, and background noise, so ranks compare detectability-weighted activity, not abundance.
Day boundaries follow the BirdWeather API's daily bins.

Detections through `r m$data_through`; rendered `r m$rendered`.
:::

### Column {width="45%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Static summary (top 8, 28-day rank)"
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 6
library(ggplot2)
sp  <- data.table::as.data.table(payload$species)[seq_len(min(8, .N))]
day <- as.Date(m$first_day + seq_len(m$n_days) - 1L)
gd  <- sp[, .(date = day, rank = payload$series$r28[idx * m$n_days + seq_len(m$n_days)]), by = common_name]
ggplot(gd[!is.na(rank) & rank <= 10], aes(date, rank, colour = common_name)) +
  geom_step(linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_y_reverse(breaks = 1:10) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#009E73", "#F0E442",
                                 "#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#CC79A7", "#000000"), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Date", y = "Rank (trailing 28-day detections)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```
